Bank tile logic for sanitizing, executing, committing, hashing, and publishing microblocks and bundles.

# Purpose
This file implements the `bank` tile for the transaction processing pipeline. It receives packed microblocks or bundles from the pack tile, filters fragments that belong to its own bank tile, copies transaction data into output memory, and then loads, sanitizes, executes, and commits transactions through external bank APIs such as [`fd_ext_bank_load_and_execute_txns`](<#fd_ext_bank_load_and_execute_txns>), [`fd_ext_bank_execute_and_commit_bundle`](<#fd_ext_bank_execute_and_commit_bundle>), and [`fd_ext_bank_commit_txns`](<#fd_ext_bank_commit_txns>). It also handles special cases such as simple vote transactions, bundle execution rules, compute unit accounting, rebate calculation, and publication of processed microblocks and rebate records to downstream tiles.

The file also manages bank tile state and metrics. The `fd_bank_ctx_t` context stores scratch memory, hash state, rebate state, workspace ranges, and counters for transaction outcomes. Helper functions compute scratch size, write metrics, hash executed transactions into a Merkle root, and publish output fragments through `fd_stem_publish`. The tile is registered at the end as `fd_tile_bank`, which connects the callback functions for fragment handling and initialization into the `stem` runtime.

- `fd_ext_bank_load_and_execute_txns`
